title: World Manufacturing Production and Trade - Quarterly Report (Q1 2026) | UNIDO Statistics Portal
snippet:
In the first quarter of 2026, global manufacturing production and exports have moved in broadly similar directions, albeit with differing magnitudes:

For higher-technology goods, the growth was even more pronounced: [...] UNIDO Statistics publishes this quarterly report to present the latest trends in manufacturing production and trade across major sectors and country groups. The report is based on official data collected directly from national statistical offices, supplemented by UNIDO’s most recent estimates. All statistical insights are based on harmonized and seasonally adjusted series, enabling direct comparisons across time periods, economies, and sectors. [...] Production figures are based on indices of industrial production (IIPs), while trade data reflect manufacturing exports and imports measured in current US dollars. Quarterly IIPs are currently available for approximately 135 countries, covering 98.6 per cent of global manufacturing value added (MVA). Quarterly manufacturing trade data include around 85 countries, representing around 90 per cent of total manufacturing trade.

title: Key statistics and trends in international trade 2025
snippet:
Intermediate goods remained the largest category, at 41% of total.
 Capital and consumer goods reached record levels.
 Processed goods expanded, while primary goods declined.

At a more detailed level:

 Machinery and precision instruments led manufacturing growth.
 Coffee, tea, spices and prepared foods drove agricultural trade.
 Mineral fuels declined, mainly due to falling prices.

Services lead trade growth, but manufacturing remains the largest share [...] The report shows that trade reached a new high in 2025, even as these structural shifts continue. Understanding these trends is essential for navigating a more complex and less predictable global economy.

#### Global trade reaches a record, driven mainly by goods

Global trade in goods and services surpassed $35 trillion in 2025 – a new all-time high. Goods made up roughly three quarters of the total. Services accounted for the remainder.

Growth in 2025 was strong across both: [...] South-South trade exceeded $6 trillion in 2024, about one quarter of global goods trade.
 Developing economies recorded around 5% growth in exports and imports.
 But developed economies still dominate overall trade, with 54% of global exports and 58% of global imports.

Developing economies drive global trade growth, but regional imbalances persist
